rust.entrypoints: Headless workspace, all targets and features; decodex-runtime tests are in its lib target.

symptoms: A legacy Free account could supply API credentials.

scope_matrix.limit: Matrix cases are inputs within a Rust test, not additional Rust test identities.

initial_unmatched_selector.disposition: Corrected to the source-declared test class; no test pass credited to the empty filter.

selected_runtime_qualification.limit: Reuse the original artifact within its existing recorded limits. This local admission change does not constitute new native account or provider qualification.
